topic: Compare alternatives to LocalStack for local AWS service emulation, given that LocalStack is moving to a fully paid/subscription model for commercial use. Evaluate nahuelnucera/ministack, hectorvent/floci, and any other viable open-source alternatives. Focus on practical usability for development and CI/CD pipelines.
goal: A decision-ready comparison report for a team currently using LocalStack that needs to evaluate whether to pay for LocalStack Pro or migrate to an open-source alternative. Include migration effort estimates, service coverage gaps, and a clear recommendation.
explored_dimensions: AWS service coverage (S3, SQS, SNS, Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, IAM, CloudFormation)
Community activity, maintenance status, and bus factor
Migration effort from LocalStack (config, SDK compatibility, breaking changes)
CI/CD integration: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Docker-in-Docker constraints
CloudFormation and IaC toolchain compatibility (Terraform, CDK, SAM)
MiniStack CloudFormation provisioner source analysis and v1.3.6 parity verification
Migration effort estimation by team profile and IaC toolchain
API compatibility and behavioral fidelity vs real AWS for core services
